instruction: Change my amazon review about the grey t-shirt I ordered last calendar month. Make it 1 star with the title "Shrunk and Misshaped After First Wash!".
notes: Single-app (amazon) task. Information gathering chain: show_orders (find the order placed last calendar month, April 2023) -> show_order (find the grey t-shirt product id) -> show_product (confirm product type t-shirt / color grey) -> show_product_reviews filtered by the supervisor's email (find the review id). Then update_product_review with rating 1 and the required title; the review is updated, not deleted/re-created, matching the evaluation (exactly one updated ProductReview). Order/product/review relations (ordered-last-month, order-contains, grey-tshirt, reviewed) are static init facts standing in for the database contents; known-id tracks ids discovered by lookups. supervisor-complete-task carries the review/rating/title records as non-API parameters so its precondition equals the problem goal; it is forced last by (not (task-completed)) on every other action. The amazon app is a domain constant and is not redeclared in the problem objects.
